name: Optimus Healthcare Services, Inc.
summary: Optimus Healthcare Services, Inc., based in Westbury, New York, operates in two key areas within the healthcare sector. Firstly, the company empowers community oncology practices by providing the essential infrastructure and support required to enroll their patients in clinical trials. Optimus also partners with pharmaceutical companies and contract research organizations (CROs) to conduct comprehensive clinical studies, spanning all phases (I-IV), for investigational drugs, biologics, and medical devices. Secondly, Optimus manages a software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform that integrates telehealth and compliance technologies. This platform is designed to establish personalized intervention pathways, primarily serving chronic care patients who are managing opioid or other substance use disorders, as well as individuals receiving treatment for pain management.
